title: Replacement Appraisal Charge in Retention Payoff Approvals
content:
Training note — Replacement appraisal charge (Payoff and Loan Satisfaction)

**The rule.** On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the replacement appraisal charge enters the retention balance figure. The replacement appraisal charge is USD 295.00, the update appraisal fee, when the maturity case's appraisal date falls on or after the effective date of the case's latest granted extension and no more than the case plan's appraisal ordering period of calendar days after it; it is USD 395.00, the replacement appraisal fee, when that does not hold and the appraisal date is more than the appraisal ordering period of calendar days after the case's due-and-payable date; a case with no appraisal date, or whose appraisal falls within neither span, carries nothing (0.00). The records are those of the loan's maturity case under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product.

**Questions and answers.**

*Which extension counts?* The latest granted extension entry on the maturity case, by its effective date.

*Is an appraisal dated on the extension's effective date inside the first span?* Yes; the span begins on that date and ends the ordering period's last day after it.

*When does the replacement fee apply?* Only when the first span does not hold and the appraisal is dated more than the ordering period after the due-and-payable date.

*What if neither holds?* Nothing is carried.

| Hypothetical maturity case (ordering period taken as 30 days for the illustration) | Result |
|---|---|
| Latest granted extension effective on day 0; appraisal dated day 0 | update fee, USD 295.00 |
| Latest granted extension effective on day 0; appraisal dated day 30 | update fee, USD 295.00 |
| Latest granted extension effective on day 0; appraisal dated day 31; due-and-payable date 200 days before the appraisal | replacement fee, USD 395.00 |
| No granted extension; appraisal dated 45 days after the due-and-payable date | replacement fee, USD 395.00 |
| No granted extension; appraisal dated 20 days after the due-and-payable date | nothing |
| No appraisal date on the case | nothing |

The 30-day ordering period is hypothetical; each maturity case uses its own plan's period.
